안경도 K패션 시대다. 합리적인 가격대에 개성 있는 디자인을 앞세운 국내 아이웨어 브랜드의 존재감이 커지고 있다. 2030세대와 외국인 관광객 쇼핑 코스로 자리 잡은 데 이어 최근엔 인공지능(AI) 스마트 안경 시장까지 영역을 넓히는 모습이다.

25일 업계에 따르면 롯데백화점은 다음 달 7일까지 잠실 롯데월드몰에서 유통업계 최초로 국내 아이웨어 브랜드 더블러버스 팝업스토어를 선보인다. 올해 들어 지난달까지 롯데백화점의 K아이웨어 매출은 전년 동기 대비 15% 증가했다. 전체 매출에서 2030세대가 차지하는 비중은 40%에 달했다. 같은 기간 외국인 매출도 10% 올랐다.

롯데백화점...

top5_headlines.title: “ 차라리 사자 ” 서울 전세금 빼 경기도 行… 청년 생애 첫 매수, 작년보 ...
top5_headlines.summary: 구리 4월매수 44%는 서울시민 내달 서울 신축 450가구 그쳐 서울내 생애 첫 매수는 소폭↓ 서울 관악구 아파트에 3년째 전세로 살고 있던 30대 직장인 윤모 씨는 최근 경기 용인시 기흥구 아파트를 샀다. 서울 외곽 지역으로 꼽혔던 관악구조차 아파트값과 전셋값이 크게 오르면서 경기도로 밀려나야 하는 처지가 된 탓이다.

top5_headlines.title: 작년 관세 수입 7.6조원 … 부과액 기준 중국산이 26%
top5_headlines.summary: 관세청 소관 세수 68조9천억원…전체 국세의 18% 차지 평택항에 쌓여있는 컨테이너 (평택=연합뉴스) 홍기원 기자 = 미국 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 국가별 상호관세 무효화 이후 줄어든 관세 수입을 충당하기 위한 새 관세 도입 절차에 11일(현지시간) 착수했다.

top5_headlines.title: 구윤철 " 재정·세제·금융 총동원 "… 먹거리 물가 안정 총력전
top5_headlines.summary: 핵심요약 먹거리 물가안정 관계기관·협회 대표들과 간담회 할인지원·공급확대 등 민생물가 대책 논의 "유통구조 개선·물가 모니터링 강화" 주문 구윤철(오른쪽 두 번째) 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 25일 서울 영등포구 한국수출입은행에서 열린 물가 관계기관 간담회에서 모두발언을 하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 제조업 체감경기, 수출·대기업 중심 호조…" 3년10개월 來 최고 "
top5_headlines.summary: IT 수출 호조, 제조업 CBSI 101.2…두 달째 장기평균 상회 비제조업, 전월 가정의 달 연휴 특수 기저효과로 하락 전 산업 체감경기 끌어내려…3개월 만에 내림세 전월 '낙관'으로 돌아선 제조업 체감 경기가 소폭 더 개선되며 3년10개월 만에 최고치를 나타냈다.

top5_headlines.title: “ 올해 2.7% 성장 전망 …반도체 쏠림 경계해야”
top5_headlines.summary: 한경연 “잠재 성장률 0.7%P 상회” 반도체 특수에 역대급 경상수지 예상 “핵심과제, 비반도체·내수 온기확산” 올해 우리나라 경제 성장률이 잠재성장률을 웃도는 2.7%를 기록할 것으로 전망되지만 반도체 수출 호황에 지나치게 의존하고 있어 낙관론을 경계해야 한다는 경고 목소리가 나왔다.

key_headlines.title: Young Seoul residents fleeing to Gyeonggi Province as housing prices surge
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment prices and jeonse (long-term deposit) rents have risen significantly, forcing young first-time homebuyers to relocate to Gyeonggi Province. In April, 44% of apartment purchases in Guri were made by Seoul residents seeking more affordable options.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's 2026 economic growth forecast at 2.7% amid semiconductor concentration risks
key_headlines.summary: Korea's economy is projected to grow 2.7% this year, exceeding the potential growth rate of 2.0%, but economists warn of excessive dependence on semiconductor exports. The Korea Economic Research Institute emphasized the need to diversify growth drivers beyond semiconductors to non-semiconductors and domestic consumption.

key_headlines.title: Manufacturing sentiment reaches 3-year-10-month high driven by semiconductor and export strength
key_headlines.summary: The manufacturing Business Survey Index (CBSI) reached 101.2, marking the highest level in 3 years and 10 months, driven by strong IT exports and major company performance. The index has exceeded the long-term average for two consecutive months.

key_headlines.title: Household debt reaches 88% of GDP, exceeding advanced country averages
key_headlines.summary: According to the Bank of Korea's Financial Stability Report, household and corporate debt levels approach twice the economic size, significantly surpassing major advanced nations. This debt level represents a potential economic risk requiring monitoring.

key_headlines.title: Public rental housing competition surges with 91,772 applicants for Seoul Happy Houses
key_headlines.summary: Seoul Housing and Urban Development Corporation received 91,772 applications for Happy House public rental housing, achieving an average competition ratio of 48.7:1. The unprecedented competition reflects worsening jeonse market conditions and strong demand for affordable housing.

sections.Hot Economy News: Young Seoul residents are increasingly migrating to Gyeonggi Province to purchase homes as Seoul apartment prices and jeonse deposits have risen significantly beyond affordability levels. Korea's economic growth is projected at 2.7% for 2026, exceeding the potential growth rate, but this growth heavily relies on semiconductor exports, raising concerns about economic diversification. Manufacturing sentiment has reached its highest level in 3 years and 10 months at 101.2, driven by strong semiconductor and IT export performance. Deputy Prime Minister Gu Yun-chul announced comprehensive anti-inflation measures mobilizing fiscal, tax, and financial policies to stabilize food prices. Meanwhile, household debt has reached concerning levels at 88% of GDP, surpassing advanced country averages.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's 2026 economic growth is forecasted at 2.7%, up significantly from last year's 1.1%, but exceeds the 2.0% potential growth rate largely due to semiconductor sector strength. Consumer price inflation is expected to reach 2.7%, surpassing the Bank of Korea's 2.0% target, though Middle East-related risks have eased recent upward pressures on oil prices and exchange rates. The government announced comprehensive measures to stabilize food prices through fiscal, tax, and financial support, including distribution improvements and supply expansion. Household debt levels have reached 88% of GDP, approaching twice the economic size and significantly exceeding advanced country averages. Import tariff revenues totaled 7.6 trillion won last year, representing 18.4% of total national tax revenue, with Chinese products accounting for 26% of tariff assessments.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI experienced strong gains in the mid-to-late 4000s range driven by institutional buying, while the KOSDAQ declined. The won-dollar exchange rate rose 5.09 won to 1,547.8 won per dollar, approaching the 1,550 won level due to dollar strength and foreign investor net selling. The U.S. Federal Reserve's recent FOMC meeting signaled fewer rate hikes than anticipated, with markets pricing in an 85% probability of a 25-basis-point increase by September. JPMorgan raised its KOSPI target to 15,000, though the investment bank specifically warned against certain technology stocks due to overvaluation concerns. Leverage-related products have amplified market volatility, with concerns about rebalancing risks during market corrections.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korea faces challenges in competing for humanoid robot dominance as the U.S. and China aggressively pursue development, despite Korea's earlier technological leadership. The battery industry focus is shifting from electric vehicles to solid-state batteries and energy storage systems (ESS), driven by growing AI power demand. Korea possesses world-class semiconductor and battery technology advantages that are crucial for humanoid robot competitiveness, with leading companies positioned across these sectors. France and other countries have expressed interest in collaborating with Korean robot developers to capitalize on this technological window. China's new energy industry, led by companies like NIO and Gotion High-tech, is rapidly expanding through integrated electric vehicle-battery-renewable energy ecosystems.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment jeonse deposits have seen their largest 13-year increase, with prices accelerating 0.3% weekly in late June, while regional areas like Dongtan saw prices jump 5.9% in three weeks. Public rental housing demand has surged dramatically, with the Seoul Happy House receiving 91,772 applications for limited availability, achieving a 48.7:1 average competition ratio. New apartment developments are being announced across regions, including projects in Miryang with 540 units at affordable prices under price caps, and the Jangwi 10-district redevelopment with 1,931 units in Seoul. The extreme scarcity of affordable housing in Seoul has driven younger buyers and renters toward Gyeonggi Province and public housing options, with monthly rentals now available in Seoul Happy Houses for 400,000 won.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve, under new Chair Kevin Walsh, signaled fewer rate hikes than markets anticipated, disappointing global investor expectations for multiple cuts in early 2026. U.S. major banks passed stress tests demonstrating sufficient capital to withstand severe recessions including 10% unemployment, 39% commercial real estate value decline, and 30% housing price drops. President Trump continued criticizing European NATO members for insufficient defense spending, claiming most have not met their 5% GDP commitment despite six-month-old agreements. U.S. stock markets experienced mixed performance with technology stocks facing selling pressure, causing the NASDAQ and S&P 500 to decline while the Dow Jones rose. The dollar index surged from 99.53 to 101.42 following the FOMC meeting, strengthening the dollar against other currencies.
sections.AI & Economy: SK Ecoplanks is accelerating growth strategies centered on semiconductors and AI infrastructure, with major opportunities from SK Hynix's expanded investments in the Yongin semiconductor cluster and future global expansion plans. OpenAI unveiled its first custom AI chip called 'Jalapeno' designed for inference tasks with improved cost-efficiency, joining other big tech companies in developing proprietary chips to reduce AI operational costs. Micron Technology reported record Q3 results with revenues of $41.46 billion, four times higher than year-ago figures, and projected fourth-quarter revenues of $50 billion, exceeding market expectations and dispelling AI investment bubble concerns. Government and industry leaders agreed that physical AI and manufacturing-focused AI development, combined with full-stack AI ecosystems, should become core pillars of national competitiveness strategy. Memory semiconductor suppliers including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are positioned to benefit from sustained AI infrastructure investments, with projections indicating continued demand growth through 2027 and beyond.
sections.Others: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that frozen Iranian funds will be managed by the Treasury Department, with substantial portions directed toward purchasing American food and agricultural products. Incheon City faces a fiscal shortfall of 458.5 billion won in the second half, attributed to declining national tax revenues and reduced local allocation taxes in recent years. Minister of Strategy and Finance Park Hong-geun pledged that total education funding would not decrease despite restructuring plans, committing to increase per-student allocations. Korean actuator technology company Enertork is advancing global market expansion with a product launch in Ho Chi Minh City targeting Southeast Asian, Middle Eastern, and European markets. The company asserts its competitive capability against established European manufacturers like AUMA and ROTORK based on proven installations in Korean nuclear plants and the UAE's Barakah nuclear facility.
